claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.modify_roll_substitute
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature is a passive floor/substitution on completed Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The current surface has numeric modifiers and advantage/disadvantage riders, but no honest way to replace a roll total with a minimum value derived from an ability score.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If your total for a Strength check or Strength saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.
